items.title: Pay flex desk invoice for December 2026
items.quote: Please settle this invoice within 14 days of the invoice date.
items.computation: Start of period: invoice date 21 Nov 2026 (a Saturday). Under §187 Abs. 1 BGB the day of the triggering event is not counted, so the 14-day period begins 22 Nov 2026 and runs 14 days, ending 5 Dec 2026 (21 Nov + 14 days = 5 Dec, same weekday as 21 Nov, i.e. Saturday). This is a payment owed to a company, so the payer's own Land (NW) governs the §193 BGB weekend/holiday extension. 5 Dec 2026 is a Saturday, which is covered by §193 BGB (Sonnabend), so the deadline moves to the next working day. 6 Dec 2026 is a Sunday, so the next working day is Monday 7 Dec 2026. No NW public holiday falls in this window.
